packageRules.description: Raising the supported Node.js range is a decision for a release, not a dependency update
Only touch prototypey's published ranges when an update falls outside them, so in-range updates don't trigger a release
CI doesn't exercise the release workflow, so majors of release tooling need a manual merge
Majors of vite and its plugins depend on each other, so land them together
typescript-eslint has to support a TypeScript major before we can take it, so hold majors for approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead of opening a PR that can't pass CI
